delivered_state: boards as sold, unfinished, standard thickness
constituents: wood strands incl. moisture; pMDI binder; paraffin wax and additives
constituent_shares_kg_per_kg: 0.951; 0.0339; 0.0149 (median of 3 EPDs, normalised; sum 0.9998 after rounding)
constituent_sources: Egger EPD-EGG-20240403-IBD2 https://cdn.byggtjeneste.no/nobb/5d36f435-3690-467d-bea3-7316879f18da; Sonae Arauco EPD-SON-20220209-ICC3 https://www.sonaearauco.com/media/huhpryfz/epd_osb_oriented-strand-board_val2027.pdf; Kronospan EPD-KRO-20230157-CBA1 https://medias.groupe-samse.fr/Fiche_de_declaration_Environnementale_et_Sanitaire/Fiche_de_declaration_Environnementale_et_Sanitaire_892469.pdf (all in ÖKOBAUDAT OBD_2024_II class 3.2.04)
manufacturing_steps: debarking; flaking; drying; screening; blending with resin and wax; mat forming; continuous hot pressing; cooling; trimming/sanding; packing
steps_source: Sonae Arauco and Egger EPDs (https://www.sonaearauco.com/media/huhpryfz/epd_osb_oriented-strand-board_val2027.pdf; https://cdn.byggtjeneste.no/nobb/5d36f435-3690-467d-bea3-7316879f18da); D1 yes so steps are inside the ecoinvent dataset

constituents: hemp shiv (as ecoinvent hemp hurd, 2 % moisture); lime binder (hydraulic lime + hardener); water (equilibrium moisture)
constituent_sources: Schönthaler hemp stone EPD BAU-EPD-SCHOENTHALER-2025-1 (https://www.bau-epd.at/fileadmin/user_upload/epds_Deutsch/BAU-EPD-SCHOENTHALER-2025-1-ECOINVENT-Hanfsteine-20250923_Webseite.pdf): ranges 20-55 % shiv / 45-80 % binder; pinned by biogenic C 56.1 and 54.4 kg C/m3 / 0.4548 kg C/kg hurd (ecoinvent property), dry density 335/360, equilibrium density 405/430 kg/m3; mean of the 2 datasets
manufacturing_steps: batch mixing of shiv, binder and water; pressing in block moulding machine; air drying; palletising. ROUTE (D5): EPD process; processing energy proxy = concrete block production DE energy inputs (0.002 kWh electricity + 0.0216 MJ diesel per kg)

constituent_sources: Amorim Cork Insulation ICB EPD HUB-0281 (https://clfbritishcolumbia.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/Novel-Expanded-Insulation-Corkboard.pdf): 100 % bio-based, cork only; ÖKOBAUDAT generic 'Expanded cork' has no composition table
manufacturing_steps: grinding to granules; autoclave expansion/agglomeration with superheated steam; cooling; stabilisation; cutting; packing
steps_source: EPD HUB-0281 (https://clfbritishcolumbia.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/Novel-Expanded-Insulation-Corkboard.pdf); D1 variant so steps are inside the dataset
